headline: The game has finished its startup sequence on the M5 Pro. Work is now on the macOS services it needs to keep running.
currentWork: Connect the game’s background tasks and pause and resume notifications to macOS, then launch it again.
graphicsStatus: Two separate graphics tests have drawn images with code from the game. The running game has yet to draw into a Mac window.

milestones.title: Offline platform runtime initialized
milestones.detail: The game found and called the native implementation of its platform startup interface.

milestones.title: The startup table completed
milestones.detail: The arm64 executable finished all 1,115 entries in the game’s C runtime initialization table.

milestones.title: The game requested graphics memory
milestones.detail: The game opened the M5 Pro’s Metal device. All seven early memory allocations succeeded.

milestones.title: The game entered its executable
milestones.detail: Seven bundled libraries initialized before the game started on its own Mac thread.

milestones.title: Real shaders rendered offscreen
milestones.detail: Two Metal tests used shaders from the game. Both checked the result across 4,096 pixels.

stages.title: Verify the game files
stages.detail: All 108 files in the Xbox package matched their expected contents.

stages.title: Run the game’s startup code on the Mac
stages.detail: The game’s early startup code ran directly on the M5 Pro and completed all 1,115 setup steps.

stages.title: Connect the game to macOS services
stages.detail: Graphics memory and basic offline services work. This stage finishes when the game gets through its remaining system requests and can begin drawing.
stages.blocker: Startup stops when the game asks to be notified if the app pauses or resumes.
stages.nextTest: Connect those notifications and the game’s background tasks to macOS. Launch the game again and check that startup gets past this request.

stages.title: Show the first game image in a Mac window
stages.detail: Two separate graphics tests have drawn images using game code. This stage finishes when the game itself draws an image in its own window.

stages.title: Use the game menu
stages.detail: Open the game menu and verify that a player can select an option with a keyboard or controller.

stages.title: Play a scene
stages.detail: Load the game world, move the character, and check that the picture and controls keep responding during play.
